Latent factor: Standardized loadings and standard errors from the orthogonal bifactor Genomic Structural Equation Modelling analysis used for the shared-component genome-wide association study. G denotes the shared pan-vascular factor; AORTIC denotes the aortic-domain factor; ATHERO denotes the systemic vascular-domain factor. Full phenotype names accompany abbreviated phenotype labels. The three latent factors were mutually orthogonal.
